# Preface {.unnumbered}
![](cover.jpg){fig-align="center" width=50%}

`rfaR` implements the RMC Reservoir Frequency Analysis (RMC-RFA) methodology
in R, producing reservoir stage-frequency curves with uncertainty bounds by
combining deterministic Modified Puls flood routing with a nested Monte Carlo
framework.

This manual complements the [function reference site](https://usace-rmc.github.io/rfaR/)
generated by pkgdown. Where the pkgdown site documents individual functions,
this manual explains the methodology, workflow, and how the pieces fit
together.

## How to cite

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
citation("rfaR")
```
